name: Creality Falcon A1 10W
tagline: Creality's compact enclosed A1 : beginner-friendly diode in a small footprint
tldr: Creality Falcon A1 10W packs a diode engraver into an enclosed desktop body with Creality's software ecosystem. Less power than Falcon 2 Pro, but easier to live with in small spaces.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Entry enclosed Falcon A1 for safer home engraving
Lower price than A1 Pro dual-source
cons: Smaller bed than open Falcon2 lines
A1 Pro adds IR for more materials
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W module on Creality Falcon A1. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
